skirmish.module.custom_sky.name: Custom Sky
skirmish.module.custom_sky.description: A sky only on your screen: stars with the galaxy band, northern lights, a golden sunset or a quasar with its disk and jets. Drawn behind the terrain, mostly at night (fading in at dusk), weaker in rain; the overworld only.
skirmish.module.custom_sky.setting.by_da: Also show it in daytime, at full strength
